player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''DMX69''') posted a [[Dark]] [[ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents|ISB Operations]] list on DeckTech in May 2001.
description: Crayzee monkies runnin around who claim to be ISB agents.
cards: posted: OBJ- ISB/ Be Afraid, Very Afraid
notes: Byline 'Fred "DMX69" Durst' uses a rock singer's name as a joke with no real-name signature; credited as DMX69.

Starting cards as posted under 'Start - (6)': ISB, Prep'd Defense, First Strike, Secret Plans, Something Special Planned For Them, Coruscant. They are listed again, marked (S), in their sections, so the Start block is not counted twice; the objective is posted as 'OBJ- ISB/ Be Afraid, Very Afraid'. Three Effects start, none named as the starting Effect, so starting.effect is left empty.
Posted 'ISB' / 'OBJ- ISB/ Be Afraid, Very Afraid' dested ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents ('Be Afraid, Very Afraid' is not a card).
Posted 'Bargaining Table' (a Light card) dested Den Of Thieves because the strategy says: 'Bargaining Table is lightside, it should be Den Of Thieves'.
Posted 'Tooex' dested 2X-7KPR (Tooex); 'Iggy w/gun' dested IG-88 With Riot Gun; '4-Lom w/gun' dested 4-LOM With Concussion Rifle; 'Probe Droid Telementry' dested Probe Telemetry.
Posted 'Jabba's Palace x2' dested the Dark site Tatooine: Jabba's Palace; 'Tatooine' dested the Dark Premiere system; 'Coruscant' dested the Dark Special Edition system.
Strategy also says 'Take out a Fozec for a Chyler'; the list is kept as posted.
Section counts posted as Start (6), Characters (28), Effects (10), Interrupts (14), Sites (9); the cards as listed total 58 (objective included), not 60. Kept as published.
